# Vayam Global Exim — Multi-page Website

## Included
- 10+ SEO-focused HTML pages
- Shared CSS and JavaScript
- Responsive sticky navigation and mobile menu
- WhatsApp floating CTA
- Quote form that builds WhatsApp or email enquiries
- Organization / LocalBusiness JSON-LD
- FAQ structured data
- Canonical tags, Open Graph and Twitter metadata
- robots.txt and sitemap.xml
- Apache .htaccess for HTTPS, clean URLs, compression and caching
- Internal links focused on spices, staples, packaged food and private label

## Deployment
Upload the contents of this folder to the web root for vayam-global.com.
Keep /assets/images/vayam-logo.png available on the live domain (the current live logo URL is referenced).
If your host is not Apache, reproduce the clean-URL rewrites in Nginx / hosting settings, or change canonical + sitemap URLs to use .html.

## Important SEO notes
No website can guarantee #1 Google ranking for broad terms such as "exim" or "spices".
For strongest brand/organic performance:
1. Verify the domain in Google Search Console and submit /sitemap.xml.
2. Keep Google Business Profile name/address/phone consistent with the site.
3. Build genuine buyer-facing category content over time (spice specifications, sourcing guides, destination documentation guides).
4. Earn relevant links/citations from trade directories, supplier/buyer partners and export associations.
5. Add optimized original product/warehouse/packing images in WebP/AVIF with descriptive alt text.
6. Monitor Core Web Vitals and search queries, then improve pages based on actual impressions/clicks.
7. Do not create keyword-stuffed doorway pages for misspellings such as "vyam"; Google generally handles brand spelling variants through entity signals and consistent citations.
